items.stem: Why can over-reliance on default AI drafting hurt a creator over time?

options.text: It can flatten a distinctive voice and reduce audience trust
options.rationale: Correct: generic output can erode the authenticity audiences follow for.

options.text: It guarantees the content goes viral
options.rationale: AI drafting does not guarantee reach.

options.text: It makes every post unique automatically
options.rationale: Default AI output often sounds generic, not unique.

options.text: It removes the need for any editing
options.rationale: Editing is still needed for quality and voice.

items.explanation: Correct: generic output can erode the authenticity audiences follow for.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO practices keep AI-assisted content compliant and trustworthy? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Disclose AI-generated media where a platform or audience expects it
options.rationale: Correct: disclosure meets policy and maintains trust.

options.text: Check that AI outputs do not infringe others' work
options.rationale: Correct: infringement review avoids legal and takedown risk.

options.text: Pass off AI-generated media as a real recording
options.rationale: Misrepresenting synthetic media is deceptive and often against policy.

options.text: Ignore platform rules on AI content
options.rationale: Ignoring rules risks removal or penalties.

items.explanation: Correct: disclosure meets policy and maintains trust.

items.stem: A creator uses AI to draft a tutorial that states a product does something. Before publishing, they should:

options.text: Verify the claim is accurate and add their own tested insight
options.rationale: Correct: verification and original insight protect accuracy and value.
Unverified claims can mislead the audience.

options.text: Assume the AI tested the product
Add hype to make it more engaging
options.rationale: Hype does not fix an unverified claim.

items.explanation: Correct: verification and original insight protect accuracy and value.
